name: product-requirements
description: Create, refine, and review product requirements documents (PRDs) for software products and features.

interface.longDescription: Turn a product idea, notes, or a feature request into a clear, testable product requirements document: goals, target users, user journeys, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, success metrics, scope, and rollout. Works step by step with you: proposes options, shows a diagram, and asks one decision at a time before drafting.
defaultPrompt: Write a PRD for a personal expense tracking app
Turn these meeting notes into requirements with acceptance criteria
Review this PRD and list what is missing
